title: Add Receipt Fortune Teller to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Receipt Fortune Teller](https://oracle.shipr.app) to chat
- Receipt Fortune Teller converts receipts, grocery lists, and small purchase lists into AI fortune readings and tarot-style card art. It uses submitted text to generate the results.

Fixes #11422

gist.headline: Your receipts know things
gist.blurb: Receipt Fortune Teller has joined chat. Hand it a grocery list or tiny purchase spree, and it will read the omens hiding between the line items.
gist.summary: Added Receipt Fortune Teller to the chat app directory, a tool that turns submitted receipts, grocery lists, and small purchase lists into AI fortune readings with tarot-style card art.
gist.impact: People can now discover and use Receipt Fortune Teller to turn everyday shopping text into a whimsical reading and generated tarot-inspired visuals.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is visiting a cozy little pixel-art fortune booth, wearing a tiny purple wizard hat and holding a long grocery receipt. A friendly retro terminal displays a tarot card made from receipt symbols while grocery items, flowers, and small code-plants surround the booth; the scene makes the ordinary receipt feel like a mysterious but warm oracle.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny purple wizard hat, presenting a long grocery receipt to a glowing retro fortune-teller terminal that creates a tarot-style card from receipt symbols. Lime green (#ecf874) appears prominently in the terminal glow and flower pots, with warm cream, lavender, mint, and peach gradients, pixel flowers and code-plants around a friendly garden fortune booth; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
